title: Project configuration
description: Per-project configuration file (galivelop-voices.json) read by the voice generator.

$schema.description: Schema reference so editors can validate and complete the file.

minVersion.description: Minimum generator version (semver) this project requires.

voices.description: Voice keys of the project, each with an optional description and effect chain name.

description.description: What the voice is for (free text).

effects.description: Name of the effect chain the game applies to this voice.

printModels.description: Base models to extract a print for when a reference is chosen. Omitted: every base model of common.schema.json.

delivery.description: Where the voice pack is delivered inside the project repository.

dir.description: Delivery directory, relative to the project root.

sampling.description: Default sampling of the project's takes; overridden by an order, over the engine catalog.

checks.description: Thresholds of the checks without listening (0.4.2) on each take's audio. Every field is optional; the defaults are in gvoice/checks.py (DEFAULTS, to be tuned on the Deck). Warnings never block.

silenceDbfs.description: A 20 ms window with RMS below this level (dBFS) is silence.

msPerCharMin.description: Fewer milliseconds of audio per character than this: take.too_fast.

msPerCharMax.description: More milliseconds of audio per character than this: take.too_slow.

innerSilenceMaxMs.description: A silence between voiced stretches longer than this (ms): take.long_silence.

trailingSilenceMaxMs.description: A final silence longer than this (ms): take.trailing_silence.

clippedRatioMax.description: A share of samples at full scale above this (0 to 1): take.clipping.

rmsDbfsMin.description: An RMS of the voiced windows below this level (dBFS): take.too_quiet.

listening.description: The listening sheet (0.4.3): replaces the default criteria (gvoice/listening.py). Ids must be unique.

criteria.description: The criteria, in the order they are shown.

label.description: Free text shown as is; without it, a default id uses its translated text.

eliminatory.description: A "no" warns when the take is chosen (never blocks).
